title: 第13章 入选国少第14章 亚少赛(上)
content_zh:
第十三章 入选国少
不过高军对此倒是感到一阵庆幸，因为历史上这支国青队（83国青）完全就是一个悲剧，而其中的罪魁祸首正是这支83国青的主教练王保山，正是他完全无视西亚炎热气候、在赛前训练中盲目上大量导致国青队员的体能状况普遍出了问题，结果在亚青赛中一溃千里。
更混账的是，这厮为了推卸责任，勾结领队张建强（此人于反赌扫黑风暴中入狱），将自己的责任全都推给了队员，还炮制出了所谓的“拜金四少”，令那四位原本很有潜质的少年受尽了国内媒体和无知球迷长达数年的无休止谩骂，职业生涯也因此异常坎坷，没有一人达到他们本该达到的高度......
U19去不了，高军就只能先从U17国少队踢起，但这在他看来反倒是件好事，与王保山相比，U17国少队的主教练刘春铭虽然也是个庸才，但至少心地没有那么自私恶毒，而且在比赛中给球员的自由度也较大，这无疑有利于高军的发挥。
虽然即便是世少赛，对高军来说也没有多大的锻炼价值，但是这届国少队里有不少好苗子，取得好成绩有助于提高国少队员的自信心，对他们的发展却很有好处，因而也对中国足球有利，所以高军还是决心全力以赴，如果教练能够不因为他个子矮小、身材瘦弱忽视他，而肯给他上场机会的话......
崇明基地的小球员中入选这一期U17国少的并不止高军一个，张程林与余海也同样进入了国少的集训名单，而历史上他们却没有这样的机会。这固然与他们在崇明基地受到了更好的培养、因而实力较历史同期更强有关，但更主要的原因还是徐根保的推荐，这也再次凸显了“人脉”在中国足坛有多么重要......
不过徐指导也只能帮助他们进入集训名单，能否留下来乃至打上主力，却要看他们自己的本事。而三人都没有让他失望，余海与张程林很快就分别坐稳了主力左边锋与主力右后卫的位置，而高军在首场队内训练赛中更是包揽了替补一方（当时两位队友也还是替补）的全部5个进球，助替补阵容三球大胜主力一方。
可是高军如此神勇的发挥却并未为他马上赢得国少队的主力位置，因为这支国少队现在采用的是单前锋战术（有前腰无影锋），而毛建卿在队内名气最大，同时速度力量兼备的他远比高军冲击力更强，因而只是训练赛的表现还不足以令国少队的主教练冒险使用年龄刚满14岁、而外表看上去甚至更小一些（其实高军不算发育晚，之所以显得年幼，其实是因为队里超龄球员太多。）的高军出任至关重要的单箭头，至于让高军改踢前腰位置，水平有限的刘春铭根本就没想到......
更重要的是，在亚少赛预赛阶段的前几场比赛中，国少队的表现又都还不错，性格保守的刘春铭自然不愿冒险。因此高军再有本事，也只能一直将板凳坐穿，不过穿越前就已经多次经历过类似情况的高军并未因此影响情绪，而且这次入选国少队虽然没打上主力，但他的收获却并不少......
首先余海与张程林两人都打上比赛得到了锻炼，这对他们的成长无疑很有好处；更重要的是，历史上高军国家队弟子当中个人能力最强的蒿骏敏这时正好因为所在足校解散而面临无球可踢的窘境，高军见状立即毫不客气地将他忽悠到了崇明基地，徐根保的名头与学费全免还有补贴（目前崇明基地仅有高军他们三个入选了国少队的有此待遇）的优厚待遇足以打动蒿骏敏和他的父母。
由于蒿骏敏性格内向，一直没能鼓起勇气向教练求助，因此兼任天津泰答足球学校校长的国少主帅刘春铭一开始并不知道此事，等他知道的时候蒿骏敏的父母已经跟徐根保谈妥了，不禁连连感叹泰答运气不佳。
由于这个小插曲，一直坐在板凳上的高军一度不无恶意地揣测，“莫非是这件事把教练给得罪狠了？”
不过高军终究还是等来了上场的机会，在亚少赛半决赛中，国少队遇上了超龄现象比咱们还夸张得多的也门队，包括毛建卿在内的国少队员被对方那些“胡子大叔”的身体优势压得喘不过气来，在打进一球后，也门队无耻地全线龟缩，中国队打不了反击，速度优势完全发挥不出来，而对方球员的人高马大则愈发显出了优势。眼见再这么打下去必败无疑，刘春铭终于鼓起勇气，决定派高军上场赌一把。
“余海，你就像在基地训练赛时那样传球给我就行了。”，高军一上场就首先向自己人余海打了招呼，毕竟中国人到哪儿都有派系，对于身为前锋的高军来说，如果没人传球给他、或者传得不好，他再有能耐也很难进球。
“他们太壮了，裁判又黑，我每次拿到球后刚要加速，他们就犯规，裁判根本不给牌......”，余海郁闷地抱怨道。
“那就不用下底，直接45度起球进禁区，不过千万别传又高又飘的，要低平球，球速越快越好，用射门的力量来踢，传中时不一定要局限在边路，可以向中间靠一靠，这样距离更近，准确度更高，球速也更快。”，高军抓住死球的短暂时间对余海说道。
“这样的传球谁接得到啊？”，余海不解道。
“我接得到，相信我！没时间再说了，照我刚才的话做！”，高军坚持道。
“那好吧。”，余海只得答应，可是那么高速的传球哪儿那么好接？何况以他现在的技术，大力传球的精度也是个问题......
不过本着“死马当活马医”的想法，余海再次得球后还是马上就按照高军的要求向内横切，盯他的对方后卫没有想到他会这么做，登时就被拉开了一段距离，余海终于获得了从容起脚传中的机会，他默念高军刚才的话，恶狠狠地将几乎全部的力量集中到了自己的左脚上，皮球顿时如同出膛的炮弹一样飞了出去！

Chapter 13: Selected as a national junior
However, Gao Jun felt lucky for this, because in history, this National Youth Team (83 National Youth Team) was a complete tragedy, and the culprit was Wang Baoshan, the head coach of the 83 National Youth Team. It was he who completely ignored the hot weather in West Asia and blindly exercised a lot in pre-match training, which led to widespread physical problems among the National Youth players, and the result was a disastrous collapse in the Asian Youth Championship.
What's even more confusing is that in order to shirk responsibility, this guy colluded with the team leader Zhang Jianqiang (who was imprisoned during the anti-gambling crackdown), put all his responsibilities on the team members, and concocted the so-called "Four Young Boys Who Worship Money". The four teenagers who originally had great potential suffered endless abuse from the domestic media and ignorant fans for several years. As a result, their careers were extremely bumpy, and none of them reached the heights they should have reached...
U19 cannot go, so Gao Jun can only start with the U17 national youth team, but this is actually a good thing in his opinion. Compared with Wang Baoshan, although the head coach of the U17 national youth team Liu Chunming is also mediocre, at least he is not so selfish and vicious, and he gives players more freedom in the game, which is undoubtedly beneficial to Gao Jun's performance.
Although even the World Junior Championships do not have much training value for Gao Jun, there are many good talents in this national junior team. Achieving good results will help improve the self-confidence of the national junior players, which is very good for their development, and therefore beneficial to Chinese football. Therefore, Gao Jun is determined to go all out. If the coach can not ignore him because of his short stature and thin stature, but is willing to give him a chance to play...
Among the young players at the Chongming base, Gao Jun is not the only one selected for this period of U17 national youth. Zhang Chenglin and Yu Hai also entered the national youth training list, but historically they have not had such an opportunity. This is certainly related to the fact that they have received better training at the Chongming base and are therefore stronger than the same period in history, but the more important reason is Xu Genbao's recommendation, which once again highlights how important "networks" are in Chinese football...
However, Director Xu can only help them get into the training list. Whether they can stay or even become the main force depends on their own abilities. None of the three let him down. Yu Hai and Zhang Chenglin quickly secured their positions as the main left winger and main right back respectively. In the first team training match, Gao Jun even scored all 5 goals from the substitutes (the two teammates were also substitutes at the time), helping the substitutes beat the main team with three goals.
However, Gao Jun's heroic performance did not immediately win him the main position of the national junior team, because the national junior team now adopts a single forward tactic (with a midfielder but no shadow striker), and Mao Jianqing is the most famous in the team, and at the same time, he has both speed and strength. He is far more impactful than Gao Jun, so his performance in the training game is not enough to make the national junior team. The head coach took the risk of using Gao Jun, who has just turned 14 and looks even younger (actually, Gao Jun is not considered late in development. He looks young because there are too many over-age players in the team) as the crucial single arrow. As for Gao Jun to switch to the attacking midfielder position, Liu Chunming, who has limited skills, never thought...
More importantly, in the first few games of the preliminaries of the Asian Junior Championships, the national junior team performed well. Liu Chunming, who has a conservative personality, is naturally unwilling to take risks. Therefore, no matter how capable Gao Jun is, he can only sit on the bench all the time. However, Gao Jun, who has experienced similar situations many times before time travel, did not affect his mood. Moreover, although he was not selected as the main force in the national junior team this time, he gained a lot...
First of all, both Yu Hai and Zhang Chenglin have been trained by playing games, which is undoubtedly very beneficial to their growth; more importantly, Hao Junmin, who has the strongest personal ability among Gao Jun’s national team disciples in history, is nowFacing the dilemma of having no football to play because of the dissolution of his football school, Gao Jun immediately and unceremoniously deceived him to the Chongming base. Xu Genbao's name, free tuition and subsidies (currently only Gao Jun and three of them who were selected for the national junior team in Chongming base have this treatment) were generous enough to impress Hao Junmin and his parents.
Due to Hao Junmin's introverted personality, he never had the courage to ask the coach for help. Therefore, the national youth coach Liu Chunming, who is also the principal of Tianjin Taida Football School, did not know about this at first. By the time he found out, Hao Junmin's parents had already reached an agreement with Xu Genbao, and he couldn't help but lament Taida's bad luck.
Because of this episode, Gao Jun, who had been sitting on the bench, once maliciously speculated, "Could it be that this incident has offended the coach so much?"
However, Gao Jun finally waited for the opportunity to play. In the semi-finals of the Asian Youth Championship, the national junior team met the Yemeni team, whose overage phenomenon was much more exaggerated than ours. The national junior players, including Mao Jianqing, were overwhelmed by the physical advantages of the opponent's "bearded uncles". After scoring a goal, the Yemeni team shamelessly retreated across the board. The Chinese team was unable to counterattack, and its speed advantage could not be used at all. The opponent's players were taller and larger, which increasingly showed their advantage. Seeing that he would definitely lose if he continued to fight like this, Liu Chunming finally plucked up the courage and decided to send Gao Jun to take a gamble.
"Yu Hai, just pass the ball to me like you did in the base training match." Gao Jun first greeted his own Yu Hai as soon as he came on the field. After all, Chinese people have factions everywhere. For Gao Jun, a forward, if no one passes the ball to him, or if the pass is not good, it will be difficult for him to score goals no matter how capable he is.
"They are too strong and the referee is bad. Every time I get the ball and I want to speed up, they make a foul and the referee doesn't give me a card at all..." Yu Hai complained depressingly.
"Then there is no need to go down, just kick the ball directly into the penalty area at a 45-degree angle. However, don't pass the ball high and floating. The ball should be low and flat. The faster the ball speed, the better. Use the power of shooting. The cross does not have to be limited to the side. You can lean closer to the center. This way, the distance is closer, the accuracy is higher, and the ball speed is faster." Gao Jun said to Yu Hai during the short time he caught the dead ball.
"Who can catch such a pass?" Yu Hai asked puzzledly.
"I can take it, trust me! There's no time to talk anymore, just do what I just said!" Gao Jun insisted.
"Okay." Yu Hai had to agree, but how could such a high-speed pass be so easy to catch? What's more, with his current skills, the accuracy of powerful passes is also a problem...
However, based on the idea of ​​"treating a dead horse as a living horse", Yu Hai immediately followed Gao Jun's request after getting the ball again. The opponent's defender who was staring at him did not expect that he would do this, and was immediately pulled away from him. Yu Hai finally got the opportunity to calmly cross the ball. He silently recited Gao Jun's words and concentrated almost all his strength on his left foot. The ball immediately flew out like a discharged cannonball!
